gaps: No official or news source says whether private vehicles and motorcycles are formally allowed between Nimmu and Padum; guides and riders' videos show them using it in 2025 and 2026.
No official order found for movement days or time windows between Nimmu and Padum; July 2026 reports conflict.

No official source says whether the road from Leh to Padum will be kept open in winter 2026–27; a Zanskar councillor expected year-round links in 2024, and guides still call the Chadar trek the winter route.
No dated official opening or closing for traffic was found for any year; 15 October 2026 was a dedication, not a traffic order.

How much of the Nimmu to Padum stretch is blacktopped in 2026 was not found; the last official figure is about 201 of 298 km for the whole road, December 2024. An encyclopedia calls the whole road paved; 2026 guides call it rough in patches.
No source names a pass between Leh and Padum; the government says the whole road crosses only Shinkun La, beyond Padum. Padum's altitude (3,669 m) is above the open map's 3,600 m top.
No source found for rockfall or slides specific to the Zanskar gorge between Chilling and Nerak, or the months they occur.
No written source lists fuel pumps between Leh and Padum; the 156 km gap is from the open map only.
No source found for mobile signal in the gorge between Nimmu and Zangla.
No source names a check post between Leh and Padum.
The Lingshed nallah closure of June 2025 comes from a forum quoting Leh disaster authority orders; the forum page could not be opened and the orders were not found.

No official channel found where the Leh disaster authority, Leh police or the new Zanskar district post status for this road; whether District Police Kargil still covers the Zanskar end was not established.
Whether foreign citizens need a Protected Area Permit for Chilling to Padum is not stated on any official page found.
Whether the Leh tourist fee applies to a Leh to Padum trip is unclear: the portal covers tourists visiting Leh, while a blogger says Zanskar-only trips need none.
Whether the restriction on rental motorcycles from outside Ladakh applies on this road was not found.
Usual season is a blogger's for Zanskar generally, not for this road.
Usual days rests on a 2024 newspaper estimate; the Prime Minister said a 12-hour journey now takes about 3 hours without naming it.
Video filming dates are not stated except 2026 in one title; four of the five run from Padum towards Leh.
